ACME WIDGETS REPORTS SECOND QUARTER 2026 RESULTS

Revenue up 22% year over year; raises full-year outlook

CLEVELAND, Ohio, July 28, 2026 — Acme Widgets Inc. (NYSE: ACME) today announced financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026.

  • Revenue of $165.0 million, up 22% from $135.0 million in the second quarter of 2025.
  • Operating income of $28.0 million; operating margin of 17.0%.

“Demand for our industrial widgets accelerated through the quarter, and the destocking that weighed on the first half of last year is behind us,” said Jane Roe, Chief Executive Officer. “We are raising our full-year revenue outlook to $660 million to $680 million.”

Gross margin was 40.0%, compared with 40.0% a year ago, as pricing offset higher freight costs in the Americas segment.
